commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1781/local
gh pr diff 1781 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1781/local/diff.patch | grep -c '^diff --git'; echo "diff-rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

git show pr-1781-head:.github/workflows/devflow.yml | sed -n '/SECURITY (issue #1773)/,/Refusing to run.\"$/p' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1781/local/g-devflow.txt
git show pr-1781-head:.github/workflows/devflow-implement.yml | sed -n '/SECURITY (issue #1773)/,/Refusing to run.\"$/p' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1781/local/g-implement.txt
git show pr-1781-head:.github/workflows/devflow-runner.yml | sed -n '/SECURITY (issue #1773)/,/Refusing to run.\"$/p' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1781/local/g-runner.txt
cm …[per-command-truncated]
for f in devflow devflow-implement devflow-runner; do echo "===== $f ====="; git show pr-1781-head:.github/workflows/$f.yml | grep -n 'denied_env_keys' ; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
